input.summary: Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript using Node.js built-in modules with in-memory stores and an event bus. Files include: src/event-bus.ts (in-memory pub/sub), services (user, project, task with status transitions and events, comment publishing events, notification subscribing to events), router.ts (HTTP API with JSON handling mapping to services), main.ts (wiring and server start), and demo.ts (starts server on 3001 and exercises full flow: users, project, members, tasks, assign, status changes, comments, notifications). Added tsconfig.json and verified compilation with npx tsc --noEmit. No external runtime dependencies; dev dependencies include typescript, @types/node, and tsx. Runnable with npx tsx src/main.ts and demo with npx tsx src/demo.ts.
